reels.title: M39 BARABAN (IG tekrar)
reels.caption:
You can't watch your way to rhythm. 🥁

Same dream, two plans. One plays drums 10 minutes a day. One watches drum covers. Day 30, off beat again. Next day, he plays again. A year later: 98% on beat vs 912 covers watched.

Listen to the groove change.

Send this to a future drummer.

#drums #drummer #practice #discipline #motivation

reels.yt_title: Free time never comes. You make it. #Shorts
reels.caption:
Free time never comes. You make it. 🎹

Same dream, two plans. One plays piano 10 minutes a day. One waits for free time. Day 30, wrong note again. Next day, he plays again. A year later: 3 songs by heart vs 365 "maybe tomorrows".

Listen to the song come together.

Send this to someone waiting for free time.

#piano #practice #discipline #habits #motivation
